item.title: Oil extends gains on little sign of progress in US-Iran talks
item.description: Oil rose Thursday, as traders assess a report that Asia is on track to import its highest volume of crude oil since the start of the US-Iran war. [Probable] Fuentes: Reuters, Bloomberg, CNBC

item.title: Trump to host China's Xi at White House with AI and tariffs on the agenda
item.description: President Trump will host Chinese President Xi Jinping for meetings and a state dinner on Thursday, as the world's two most powerful countries try to extend a tariff truce and grapple with a rivalry on advanced AI. [En desarrollo] Fuentes: CBS News, NBC News

item.title: La tasa hipotecaria a 30 años en EE. UU. supera el 7%, alcanzando un máximo de 2 años
item.description: La hipoteca de tasa fija a 30 años en EE. UU. ha superado el 7% por primera vez desde mayo de 2024. El colaborador de negocios de CBS News, Javier David, analiza qué está impulsando el aumento. [En desarrollo] Fuentes: Reuters, CBS News

item.title: Fed rate hike cycles have a history of denting US stock prices
item.description: John Williams was speaking at the London Macro Policy Forum on Thursday. [En desarrollo] Fuentes: Reuters, CNBC

item.title: Fed’s Barr says future interest rate hikes ‘likely’ needed to tame inflation
